notes: Tail case, all units rewritten. U1 ref unique (topmost slatted window left of the blue glass section) and 'to blue' on bluish slats -> red. U2 narrow door is in the SALLE D'EXPOSITION shopfront (ref said left), replace was a recolour -> solid wooden door. U3 bicycle is at the lower-left corner with a brown pannier (ref said lower centre); the old mask missed the pannier and saddle -> SAM3 v2 mask of the whole bicycle incl. pannier. U4 lamp is the wire-hung lamp at the upper right (ref said centre); payload/relation made concrete.
